screens.prompt:
Design an ultra-luxurious, printable guest welcome card and digital handoff modal experience for Novotel Executive Lounge Welcome Experience.

Color Palette & Theme:
- Background: Rich deep Novotel Space Cadet (#171E52) gradient gracefully fading into Blue Zodiac (#0F1155), elevated with subtle geometric starlight texture or fine luxury guilloche / watermark line work.
- Accents: Metallic champagne gold (#C5A880) fine-line filigree borders, corner flourishes, and delicate dividers.
- Typography: Crisp white and champagne gold headlines with editorial Playfair Display serif, paired with refined tracking on clean sans-serif subheadings.
- Halo & Glow: Subtle 1px Persian Blue (#1E22AA) halo around key focal elements.

Key Sections & Layout:
1. Top Luxury Header & Viewport Switcher:
   - Subtle Novotel Hotels & Resorts gold monogram crest with "EXECUTIVE LOUNGE & SANCTUARY HANDOFF".
   - Top action badges: "Printable 300 DPI Card View (16:9)", "Digital Guest Overlay (9:16)", "Print Keycard Sleeve", "Share to Room Tablet".

2. Central Hero Welcome Card (Printable 16:9 Showcase + Interactive Modal Frame):
   - Framed by metallic champagne gold (#C5A880) dual-line border with ornamental corner filigrees and delicate geometric crest.
   - Header badge: "ACCOR LIVE LIMITLESS • VIP SUITE INTEL" in gilded lettering.
   - Subtitle: "NOVOTEL HOTELS & RESORTS • YOUR SANCTUARY AWAITS" (uppercase, generously spaced tracked typography).
   - Main Editorial Heading: "Scan to Unlock Your Bespoke Stay" in elegant Playfair Display serif.
   - Central High-Contrast QR Code Display:
     - High-contrast white QR code framed inside a pristine rounded card with rounded-2xl geometry.
     - Subtle 1px Persian Blue (#1E22AA) halo with delicate soft ambient glow.
     - Center crest embedded in QR code: Novotel "N" emblem in champagne gold.
     - Dynamic caption: "Valid for Suite 412 • Julian Sterling • Lifetime VIP Tier".
     - Real-time indicator: "NFC Tap & QR Scan Enabled • Instant Pairing".

3. Bespoke VIP Perks Showcase (Bulleted with tailored iconography):
   - "Instant Pool & Tennis Court Reservation" — with live status badge "Cabana Pre-Reserved".
   - "One-Tap Towel Warming & Turndown Service" — with live status badge "Set for 21:00".
   - "Direct Butler Messaging via WhatsApp" — with live status badge "Elena S. on Duty".
   - Include clear visual micro-cards with soft dark translucent glass cards (glassmorphism on dark navy), champagne gold icons, and crisp explanatory notes.

4. Bottom Action Strip & Instant Messenger Gateway:
   - Descriptive text: "Prefer WhatsApp? Tap below to receive your private access link instantly via SMS or WhatsApp."
   - Two discrete branded action buttons:
     - [Send via WhatsApp] styled in brand dark blue (#171E52) with vibrant WhatsApp emerald green accent badge and clean chat icon.
     - [Open Direct Portal] styled in gleaming champagne gold (#C5A880) with arrow icon.
   - Secondary auxiliary actions: "Print Physical Card (PDF)", "Send to Apple Wallet", "SMS Direct Access Link".

5. Mobile Companion Preview / 9:16 Floating Overlay Panel:
   - Alongside or floating in preview mode, display the responsive 9:16 mobile overlay view showing how the guest receives this digital handoff on their smartphone lockscreen and mobile browser with digital key pass.

Elevate with flawless spacing, luxurious executive typography, crisp SVG iconography, and rich hospitality finishing touches.

outputComponents.text:
I have designed the **Novotel Executive Lounge Welcome Card & Digital Handoff** experience (Novotel Executive Lounge Welcome Card & Digital Handoff), marrying physical print luxury with frictionless contactless digital onboarding.

### Design Highlights:
1. **Executive Palette & Champagne Filigree:**
   - Deep background gradient blending Novotel Space Cadet (`#171E52`) into rich Blue Zodiac (`#0F1155`).
   - Fine-line metallic champagne gold (`#C5A880`) ornamental framing with refined corner filigrees, geometric accents, and delicate luxury borders.

2. **Hero Contactless QR Access Card:**
   - Central high-contrast QR card detailed with an embedded Novotel crest and a delicate Persian Blue (`#1E22AA`) halo glow.
   - Dual authentication tags highlighting NFC tap pairing and real-time guest credentials for *Suite 412 · Julian Sterling*.

3. **Curated VIP Perks Grid:**
   - **Instant Pool & Tennis Court Reservation** (*Cabana Pre-Reserved*)
   - **One-Tap Towel Warming & Turndown Service** (*Scheduled for 21:00*)
   - **Direct Butler Messaging via WhatsApp** (*Elena S. on Duty*)

4. **Omnichannel Digital Delivery Strip:**
   - Direct dispatch bar: *"Prefer WhatsApp? Tap below to receive your private access link instantly via SMS or WhatsApp."*
   - Two branded actions: **[Send via WhatsApp]** with signature WhatsApp accent and brand navy styling, and **[Open Direct Portal]** in brushed champagne gold.
   - Secondary actions for **Print Physical Card (PDF)**, **SMS Direct Access Link**, and **Add to Apple Wallet**.

5. **Integrated 9:16 Mobile Companion Overlay:**
   - A live 9:16 mobile mockup showing how the digital keycard pass and VIP concierge shortcuts render on the guest's personal device.
